InvestmentUpdate.title: InvestmentUpdate
InvestmentUpdate.description:
Partial update: omitted fields are unchanged, an explicit ``null`` clears ``platform``.

The other fields are not nullable, so an explicit ``null`` is a 422. Their ``None`` default
only means "not sent" (it is hidden from the JSON schema), and the service reads the sent
fields with ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)``.

TransactionUpdate.title: TransactionUpdate
TransactionUpdate.description:
Partial update: omitted fields are unchanged, explicit ``null`` clears nullable fields.

``type``, ``date``, ``amount`` and ``category_id`` are not nullable, so an explicit ``null``
is a 422. Their ``None`` default only means "not sent" (it is hidden from the JSON schema),
and the service reads the sent fields with ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)``.
